workflow: An optimizer scans a bounded instruction sequence to remove unreachable trailing content after a terminating operation.
The terminating operation is at the sequence boundary, leaving no following element to inspect.
A helper advances past the boundary because it lacks an effective end-of-sequence check.
The optimizer reads beyond the valid instruction data, causing a memory-safety failure or process termination.
decision_reason: The failure workflow is materially identical: an optimizer scans past a terminating instruction at the end of bounded data because its helper mishandles the sequence boundary, resulting in an out-of-bounds read.
